prompt:

ANATOMY: One simply shaped aquatic dragon head with two ordinary eyes and a plain reptilian snout; the minimal head rendering is an editorial interpretation of the dragon category, not an assertion of crocodilian species, a long scaled body tightly COILED with one tail; limbs if present remain entirely submerged and unseen. No horns, antlers, whiskers, wings or extra heads. [panlong-mythology-c01, panlong-mythology-c03]
MOMENT: Uncoil its neck toward the viewer from a tight circular body in shallow dark water, head dominating foreground.

SCALE & CAMERA: extremely close low camera and foreshortening, no invented giant size, no tiny people as size references; distinguishing anatomy readable at200px.
LIGHT & WEATHER: Single low warm sunlight source, wet bronze-brown scales and real spray.
SURFACE: tactile organic fur, skin, feather, scales, wet wood or opaque cloth corresponding to the documented subject, never plastic.
SETTING: An aquatic lair with the coiled body partly submerged. [panlong-mythology-c01, panlong-mythology-c05]
MOOD: reverent imposing river-dragon awe; never cute, calm, static or decorative. Dark walnut, antique-gold and parchment palette with one strong accent.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, glyph, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, arms, legs, fingers or attributes; no film, game, anime or comic adaptation; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.
